payload.core_composition_summary: Preprocessing computes max power for each endurance via suffix maxima; then greedy two-pointer scan selects maximal defeatable monster prefix each day.
payload.rationale: The solution first precomputes st array via DP (suffix max) and then uses a greedy algorithm with two pointers to optimally partition monsters into days.
